source.title: Underground thermal energy storage in mines: Field scale heating-cooling cycles and performance at the Reiche Zeche underground mine

system_context.site: Reiche Zeche underground mine, Freiberg, Germany
system_context.storage_type: Mine thermal energy storage (MTES), instrumented test bed

reported_observations.basis: Total heat supplied to test bed over the 504-day campaign
limitations: Heat supplied is not the same as heat recovered or net delivered useful service.

reported_observations.basis: Source-reported distribution of stored energy in surrounding gneiss
limitations: This is a storage-location fraction, not round-trip efficiency or recoverable-energy fraction.
The remaining stored-energy partition is not separately resolved in this fixture.

reported_observations.basis: Rock temperature rise at 1.8 m depth after the hottest cycle
Tracer-derived throughflow reported for the tested system
reported_observations.uncertainty: Published summary value; source rounding and detailed trace uncertainty not available here.

reported_observations.basis: Tracer-derived residence time reported for the tested system
reported_observations.uncertainty: Published summary value; detailed residence-time distribution not available here.
Published summary value; detailed fitted-model uncertainty not available here.

reported_observations.value: Fe(II) oxidation and Fe-oxyhydroxide precipitation dominated exchanger fouling

reported_observations.basis: Source-reported result for hydrophobic coating in the tested context
limitations: Do not generalize to other coating materials, water chemistries or exchangers.

result.basis: Independent unit conversion using nominal liquid-water density and heat capacity
limitations: This is a dimensional/physical consistency check, not an independent reconstruction of the study's fitted advective heat-loss coefficient.

derived_checks.interpretation: The computed 0.09166 kW/K is within approximately 0.38% of the reported 0.092 kW/K; rounding of flow and water properties can explain the small difference.

result.basis: Q times mean residence time under a single-compartment well-mixed interpretation
limitations: Not the total mine void, total water inventory, or fracture-matrix storage volume.
Invalid if the tracer residence-time distribution is strongly multi-path, recirculating or non-well-mixed.

derived_checks.interpretation: A conditional mobile-water volume scale only; it must not be treated as measured cavern or reservoir volume.

result.basis: 38 MWh divided by the full 504-day elapsed campaign
limitations: An elapsed-campaign average only; not installed capacity, peak power, operating power during active charging, stored energy, recovered power or delivered service.

derived_checks.interpretation: This checks only the scale of total supplied heat divided by elapsed campaign duration; operating cycles and idle periods are not resolved.

data_access.notes: The journal abstract/source summary exposes the stated aggregate values but the underlying dense thermometry, tracer, hydrochemical and materials time series are available on request. This fixture is not a reproduction of the 504-day trajectories or complete thermal/energy balance.

claim_ceiling: Published field-demonstration summary plus independent unit/arithmetic consistency checks only; no raw-data reproduction, universal MTES performance, site eligibility, environmental safety or CEA heat-service claim.
